cases.upstreamName: ChatPersistor combined record writes messages and resume snapshot as one record
cases.dartTestName: ChatPersistor combined record writes messages and resume snapshot as one record
cases.adaptation: Uses a real ChatPersistor with a synchronously backed ChatClientPersistence adapter.

cases.upstreamName: ChatPersistor combined record clears the resume snapshot but keeps messages
cases.dartTestName: ChatPersistor combined record clears the resume snapshot but keeps messages
cases.adaptation: Asserts the combined ChatPersistedState keeps messages and removes resume.

cases.upstreamName: ChatPersistor combined record normalizes a legacy bare-array record on read
cases.dartTestName: ChatPersistor combined record normalizes a legacy bare-array record on read
cases.adaptation: ChatPersistor.readInitial normalizes a List of message maps to ChatPersistedState with no resume pointer.

cases.upstreamName: localStoragePersistence ergonomics needs no type arg or codec and round-trips a ChatPersistedState
cases.dartTestName: localStoragePersistence ergonomics needs no type arg or codec and round-trips a ChatPersistedState
cases.adaptation: Dart's adapter is FutureOr rather than Promise-based; the sync WebStorage round-trip is asserted directly through localStoragePersistence.

cases.upstreamName: normalizeConnectionAdapter joinRun passthrough exposes joinRun when the connection is resumable
cases.dartTestName: normalizeConnectionAdapter joinRun passthrough exposes joinRun when the connection is resumable
cases.adaptation: Normalized SubscribeConnectionAdapter carries the real joinRun callback.

cases.upstreamName: normalizeConnectionAdapter joinRun passthrough omits joinRun for a plain connect adapter
cases.dartTestName: normalizeConnectionAdapter joinRun passthrough omits joinRun for a plain connect adapter
cases.adaptation: A connect-only adapter normalizes with joinRun == null.

cases.upstreamName: normalizeConnectionAdapter joinRun passthrough omits joinRun when the property is present but not a function
cases.dartTestName: normalizeConnectionAdapter joinRun passthrough omits joinRun when the property is present but not a function
cases.adaptation: Dart's typed ConnectionAdapter.joinRun cannot hold a non-function value, so the fixture asserts the equivalent explicit null case. No Runtime TypeError path exists.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rejoins a persisted in-flight run via joinRun
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rejoins a persisted in-flight run via joinRun
cases.adaptation: Real ChatClient + connection adapter. Asserts constructor opens no network, attach joins r1, attach is idempotent, and the restored user message survives.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload drops the hydrated assistant when the rejoin stream is chunk events
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload drops the hydrated assistant when the rejoin stream is chunk events
cases.adaptation: Chunk replay replaces the hydrated partial assistant instead of duplicating it.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload applies a replay in one batch without yielding
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload applies a replay in one batch without yielding
cases.adaptation: Injects a real StreamProcessingScheduler with a counting yieldToHost; join replay completes with zero scheduler yields.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload persistence:true hydrates history AND tails a live run from the server on mount
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload persistence:true hydrates history AND tails a live run from the server on mount
cases.adaptation: Uses canonical ConnectionAdapter.hydrate and the real server-authoritative path; paints history-1 and joins r1.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload persistence:true hydrates a transcript with no active run (no tail)
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload persistence:true hydrates a transcript with no active run (no tail)
cases.adaptation: Hydrated transcript is painted and joinRun is never called.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload persistence:true restores a pending interrupt from the server on mount
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload persistence:true restores a pending interrupt from the server on mount
cases.adaptation: Canonical hydrate interrupts are classified as generic, resolvable and keyed to run-paused; no tail is opened.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload publishes hydrate once before live client-tool cancellation
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload publishes hydrate once before live client-tool cancellation
cases.adaptation: Uses a real ClientTool output schema and hashSchemaInput (zod is replaced by raw JSON Schema hashing). Asserts hydrate source ordering, one live continuation run, parentRunId/resume payload, and no client tool execution.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload restores a pending interrupt even when hydrate also reports an activeRun
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload restores a pending interrupt even when hydrate also reports an activeRun
cases.adaptation: Same run id for activeRun and interrupts: interrupt is restored and joinRun is not called.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rejoins an active continuation run instead of restoring its parent interrupt
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rejoins an active continuation run instead of restoring its parent interrupt
cases.adaptation: Different active run id: joins run-B and leaves the parent interrupt list empty.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rebuilds a hydrated in-flight partial in place (no duplicate) when tailing on mount
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rebuilds a hydrated in-flight partial in place (no duplicate) when tailing on mount
cases.adaptation: Hydrated assistant-1 partial is rebuilt to one assistant message with the full replay text.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rejoins a live run handed to a fresh client via initialResumeSnapshot
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rejoins a live run handed to a fresh client via initialResumeSnapshot
cases.adaptation: Seeded history survives while initialResumeSnapshot tails r1.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rejoins from an async store (getItem returns a Promise)
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload rejoins from an async store (getItem returns a Promise)
cases.adaptation: Future-returning ChatClientPersistence adapter hydrates before attach resolves and then joins r1.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload KEEPS the resume pointer when joinRun times out before attaching
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload KEEPS the resume pointer when joinRun times out before attaching
cases.adaptation: The 2-second rejoin connect deadline frees the input and retains quiet-run in the persisted resume pointer.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload clears a dead resume pointer when joinRun is REFUSED before attaching
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload clears a dead resume pointer when joinRun is REFUSED before attaching
cases.adaptation: A generator throw before the first yield clears the stored resume pointer while keeping messages.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload with persistence:true a dead server-tail frees the input
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload with persistence:true a dead server-tail frees the input
cases.adaptation: Server-authoritative hydrate reports gone-run; the rejoin deadline frees isLoading without a client store.

cases.upstreamName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload surfaces post-attach rejoin errors via onError
cases.dartTestName: ChatClient auto-rejoin after reload surfaces post-attach rejoin errors via onError
cases.adaptation: Attached replay throws mid-stream; onError receives the transport failure message.
